scope: Single-pass template substitution and rejection of content-introduced template tokens

finding.before: Ordered str.replace recursively expanded tokens introduced by prior values; body FOOTER_META token could expand and CLI reported success.
finding.after: One substitution pass over template only; existing unresolved-placeholder validation rejects tokens introduced by values before writing.

validation.red_regressions: Ordered values expanded unexpectedly; real CLI accepted body FOOTER_META marker.
fixed_regressions: both value insertion orders reject nested tokens
real CLI preserves source and prior output on token failure

limits: Renderer remains PARTIAL: raw HTML, XSS, offline resource validation, SVG, actual PDF, visual validation and failure publication not closed.
This is not an HTML sanitizer or general template sandbox.
No app, commit, push or release.
